approved.en: Russia is stepping up airstrikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure, killing civilians in Zaporizhzhia and hitting power plants in Kyiv, while Ukraine says it will pause its own refinery strikes if Russia ends the energy attacks. Ukraine struck a Russian Iskander-M ballistic missile maintenance base and accused SpaceX of throttling Starlink terminals used by Kyiv forces for drones. Russian authorities detained a Japanese journalist on espionage charges and announced a diesel deal framed as an energy ceasefire, which Ukraine called false after further strikes. The UCDP recorded 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Hezbollah explosives seized in two Lebanese trucks have prompted Lebanon's prime minister and security forces to promise a thorough investigation, while Israeli artillery and air strikes continue against Hezbollah positions in southern Lebanon, causing civilian casualties. In northern Israel, a Hezbollah submunition exploded in a teenager's backpack during a hike near the Lebanon border, killing Elazar Yair Wilensky and wounding dozens, leading the IDF chief to order a probe and authorities to consider restricting hikes. Students on the same hike fashioned tourniquets from belts and socks after the blast. Hezbollah announced compensation for Lebanese homeowners whose houses were destroyed and unveiled an aid plan for displaced civilians. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024.

I Nord-Israel eksploderte en Hezbollah-submunisjon i en tenårings ryggsekk under en fottur nær Libanongränsen, og drepte Elazar Yair Wilensky og såret dusinvis, noe som fikk IDF-sjefen til å beordre en undersøkelse og myndighetene til å vurdere restriksjoner på fotturer. Studenter på samme tur laget tourniquetter av belter og sokker etter eksplosjonen. Hezbollah kunngjorde erstatning til libanesiske huseiere hvis hus ble ødelagt og presenterte en hjelpsplan for fortrengte sivile. UCDP registrerte 4 335 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024.

Four Syrian road security personnel were killed in an attack in eastern Hama. The conflict produced 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

The supreme court declared the Kurdistan Region security law unconstitutional and the Iraqi cabinet is being completed in a Thursday parliament session. Iraq detained 74 border infiltrators and advanced a security wall, and Prime Minister Barzani discussed security and investment with U.S. Consul General Wendy Green. approved.en: The Sudanese Armed Forces have launched air strikes on gold mining sites near the Sudan-Egypt border, killing dozens of miners, while the Rapid Support Forces used a paramilitary drone to strike near the Ethiopian frontier, causing additional casualties. These attacks extend fighting into civilian mining areas and the border triangle region, threatening civilians in West Kordofan. The war has already produced 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Disse angrepene utvider kampene til sivile gruveområder og trekantregionen ved grensen, og truer sivilbefolkningen i Vest-Kordofan. Krigen har allerede ført til 4 680 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Communal clashes in Lakes state, especially Rumbek, have intensified, prompting a curfew and the return of caretaker governor Rin Tueny, while UNMISS has stepped up civilian protection after deadly violence there. Two SSPDF soldiers were wounded in an attack on a Mundri West military outpost and the U.S. Embassy condemned an assault on WFP workers in Jonglei that involved looting of aid. An AIC cleric was shot dead in Juba and a Juba High Court sentenced five officers to 24 years for raiding a general's home. The lethal communal violence now far exceeds the two battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Kommunale sammenstøt i Lakes-staten, spesielt i Rumbek, har økt, noe som har ført til nattforbud og at vikar-gouverneur Rin Tueny er kommet tilbake, mens FN-misjonen UNMISS har skjerpet sivile beskyttelsestiltak etter dødelig vold der. To SSPDF-soldater ble såret i et angrep på en militærpost i Mundri West, og den amerikanske ambassaden fordømte et overfall på WFP-arbeidere i Jonglei som innebar plyndring av hjelp. En AIC-prest ble skutt og drept i Juba, og Juba høyesterett dømte fem offiserer til 24 år for å ha ransaket en generals bolig. Den dødelige kommunale volden overstiger nå langt de to kamprelaterte dødsfallene i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Ethiopian forces have entered a key town in Tigray and claimed the regional airport, while advancing toward an Eritrean border town, prompting fears of a wider war. Clashes in Amhara have left at least 183 people dead, according to the UN, and the United Nations has allocated $8.5 million for emergency humanitarian response in northern Ethiopia. Leaders from Egypt, Eritrea, Sudan and Somalia are meeting to coordinate security operations if the conflict spreads across borders. Washington has called for de-escalation as Ethiopia-Eritrea tensions rise. The conflict has caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Kamper i Amhara har etter UNs tall ført til minst 183 døde, og FN har avsatt 8.5 million dollar til nødhjelpsrespons i Nord-Etiopia. Ledere fra Egypt, Eritrea, Sudan og Somalia møtes for å koordinere sikkerhetsoperasjoner dersom konflikten sprer seg over grensene. Washington har oppfordret til de-eskalering mens spenningene mellom Etiopia og Eritrea øker. Konflikten har forårsaket 2 824 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Somalia is screening travelers after Kenya confirmed an imported Ebola case while hosting regional talks in Egypt with Eritrea, Sudan and its own officials to coordinate security amid Ethiopia-Eritrea tensions. The federal government is deepening defence ties with Pakistan, seeking JF‑17 fighter jets and securing the release of four Pakistani sailors from Somali pirates. Somali forces killed two al-Shabaab militants in the Bay region and a military court linked a father’s killing to the 2017 Mogadishu bombing case; the lower house passed a long-delayed anti-rape bill and a market shooting in Garowe left two dead and four wounded. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Somalia screener reisende etter at Kenya bekreftet et importert ebolatilfelle mens landet er vert for regionale samtaler i Egypt med Eritrea, Sudan og egne tjenestemenn for å koordinere sikkerheten midt i spenninger mellom Etiopia og Eritrea. Den føderale regjeringen utdyper forsvarstilknytningene til Pakistan, søker JF‑17 kampfly og arbeider for løslatelsen av fire pakistanske sjømenn fra somaliske pirater. Somaliske styrker drepte to al-Shabaab-militante i Bay-regionen, og en militærdomstol knyttet en fars drap til saken om bombingen i Mogadishu i 2017; underhuset vedtok en lenge utsatt anti-vold-mot-kvinner-lov, og en skyteepisode på et marked i Garowe etterlot to døde og fire sårede. Konflikten forårsaket 2 284 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.
